title: Mithril
body:
Description

Mythril spawns in Lightslate, Beigeslate, and Darkslate, Chalkyslate, Blueslate, and Smokeslate.

The raw form of Mythril takes on a deep cyan/teal color. Putting raw Mythril through a refinery raises the sell value to $125/stud. Putting refined Mythril through a forge further increases the value to $175/stud.

Trivia

  • Mythril is spelled incorrectly ingame; the proper spelling is Mithril.[1]
  • Mithril is a fictional metal, originating from J. R. R. Tolkien's Middle-earth writings, such as The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings.[2]
  • For a limited time in the testing servers, Mythril spawned in abundance near water.
